skill_gap.name: no morph point option
skill_gap.why: Roleplay & Avatar Sim ships a preset literally called Morph Roleplay, but neither its option list nor the universal six holds anything for the place a player morphs. The prompt's central request is spatial — a booth or pad in the map — and it had to be emitted as id: null, which drops the route with it.

notes_for_us: The Morph Roleplay preset carries no morph option. A genre's own named subgenre cannot express its defining feature, so the strongest match in the file still leaves the main request in free text.

genre-choice step 6 requires shape.type and shape.name from the row's Type (Flavor Name), but genre files list Typical shapes as bare IDs. The emit rule cannot be satisfied without shapes.md, which the same skill says not to load by default.
building-interior is typed Zone (Enterable Interior) but routed image only, so the VIP room is drawn and no volume is ever placed. Nothing downstream can know it is the gated room.

layout-intake's scale rule covers 'obvious from the prompt' and 'extent named without contents', but not silence on both, which is this prompt. No default band is given. Note also that this prompt is bucketed oversized-scale and states no extent at all.
Pilot prompts.json items have no enriched field, so coverage.enriched_invented cannot be filled as LANE-BRIEF.md describes.
